purpose: Development examples: prompts and decision rules may be adjusted against them.
statement: Cases for measuring the relevance decision (news_relevance) against labels. Real cases are official reports whose publishers' terms allow their use by a model, frozen as their feeds gave them (headline and excerpt) with their attribution; SYNTHETIC cases were written for the set and are marked as such. Every label is provisional: the set author's judgement, not reviewed by an editor. Paired cases share a pair: similar words, different economic meaning.
